brief: A graceful sculpted crescent in muted champagne gold opening around three small ivory rounded schedule bars, with one bar separated by a generous rest gap. A subtle indigo inset on the crescent ties night and daytime rhythm together. Crescent and schedule are one compact integrated silhouette. This is Ramadan routine planning, not astronomy or weather: no sunburst, compass, orbiting planets, stars, mosque, clock face or numerals. Colors midnight indigo #131F4D, warm ivory #FFE8B0 and muted gold #D0B87C.
prompt: Create one exceptional mobile-app BRAND SYMBOL only, an original premium dimensional 3D-style pictogram, square canvas, isolated on a fully transparent RGBA background. No lettering, no wordmark, no numbers, no canvas tile, no checkerboard baked into artwork. Use clean confident geometry and a readily recognizable functional idea, not a busy illustration. Restrained tactile ceramic and fine metal materials, soft studio lighting, crisp clear silhouette, subtly front three-quarter view, broad surfaces and few parts. The symbol must fill about 72 percent of the square in its longest dimension, centered, with generous clear alpha margins and no ground-plane drop shadow or floating debris. Must read at small sizes and on white and dark backgrounds. Keep material detail subordinate to the silhouette.
